Title: Change in verification code SMS content

Body.Content:
We are announcing a change in the verification code text message content that will remove "MSG & DATA RATES MAY APPLY" sentence that will be deployed globally, along with translations, by early November to reduce confusion about pricing.

Before our verification text message was:

Use verification code xxxxxx for <tenant name for AAD OR app name for B2C> authentication. MSG & DATA RATES MAY APPLY

Now the verification text message will be changed to:

Use verification code xxxxxx for <tenant name for AAD OR app name for B2C> authentication.
